name: raycast-job-search-hub
title: Job Search Hub
description: Manage Andrej's local job-search toolkit from Raycast.
author: andrej

preferences.name: jobSearchRoot
preferences.title: Job Search Folder
preferences.description: Private job-search repository root. Overrides CAREER_JOB_SEARCH_ROOT when set.

commands.name: job-new
commands.title: Job: New
commands.description: Create a new job posting file interactively.

commands.name: job-match
commands.title: Job: Match All
commands.description: Batch match all jobs in the inbox to CV variants.

commands.name: job-log
commands.title: Job: Log Application
commands.description: Log an application outcome to applications.csv.

commands.name: job-analytics
commands.title: Job: Analytics
commands.description: Show application pipeline and variant performance.

commands.name: job-rebuild-cvs
commands.title: Job: Rebuild CVs
commands.description: Rebuild all CV PDFs and Canva paste files.

commands.name: job-discover-opportunities
commands.title: Job: Discover Opportunities
commands.description: Discover Vilnius and Lithuania-eligible remote opportunities.

commands.name: job-daily-queue
commands.title: Job: Daily Queue
commands.description: Refresh and show fresh live Vilnius CV matches.

commands.name: job-review-opportunities
commands.title: Job: Review Opportunities
commands.description: Review fresh and scored Vilnius opportunity queues.

commands.name: job-match-opportunities
commands.title: Job: Match Opportunities
commands.description: Score saved opportunities against CV variants and fit rules.
